note: The two sets are essentially identical in content, differing only in ordering and in how the composite-layer definition is split (A keeps the full definition; B moves 'following the curved blade reference axis' into conditions, which is a minor but acceptable formatting choice). Both correctly capture the s-coordinate endpoints (0 at suction-side trailing edge, 1 at pressure-side trailing edge), the flatback trailing-edge definition, the IEA ontology standard, and the flapwise/torsional damping values. Both share the same errors: the first edgewise damping is given as 5% although the source states 3%, 3%, 6%, and the accompanying damping quotes are altered to '3%, 5%, and 6%'; both also include a nonsensical 'flatback surface | midpoint definition | normalized arc length position' claim with a garbled quote. Since the errors and correct claims are the same in both, neither is better.
